decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk extends the established office line, and post-pandemic workplace reconfiguration keeps its results near aspiration, so it does not trigger problemistic search.
The chair family is close to the core offer, uses existing craft and upholstery resources at low marginal cost, and is typically sold for many years in premium furniture.
Floor cushions made from carpets are a niche accessory whose uncertain results the firm can still carry with modest slack, but they are a likely candidate if the range is pruned.
The designer-collaboration sofa is central to the residential living offer and was promoted as new in 2019, so management will give it time to meet aspirations.
The high standing table complements the conference and lounge programs at low cost, so dropping it would release few resources.

The rug collection is distant from the core but presented as a flagship of the firm's direction, so management commitment and the long time it takes such a collection to reach aspiration favour keeping it despite the uncertainty.
